quotes.quote: Anthropic says its AI Claude has "autonomously discovered" a new enzyme system similar to machinery behind the powerful gene-editing tool Crispr.
But maybe the biggest reveal is that Anthropic has not let Claude run loose in its biology lab. Humans are still, so far, in the loop.

headline: Anthropic's biolab claims an enzyme discovery similar to Crispr
summary: Anthropic says its AI Claude found a new enzyme system similar to the mechanism behind Crispr, the first result from its newly launched wet lab. Outlets disagree on how autonomous the discovery was: one says Claude discovered it autonomously, the other that humans remain in the loop.
